title: Implement Automated Backup Testing
description: Set up automated monthly backup restoration tests to verify data integrity and recovery procedures.

title: Deploy SIEM Solution
description: Implement a Security Information and Event Management system for centralized log collection and threat detection.

title: Enforce Multi-Factor Authentication
description: Roll out MFA to all user accounts, targeting 95%+ coverage across all systems.

title: Implement Network Segmentation
description: Divide your network into isolated segments to limit lateral movement during an attack.

title: Establish Disaster Recovery Plan
description: Create and regularly test a formal disaster recovery plan with defined RTO/RPO targets.

title: Increase Security Awareness Training
description: Raise employee security training completion to 90%+ with quarterly phishing simulations.

title: Deploy Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR)
description: Install EDR solution across all endpoints for real-time threat detection and response.

title: Improve Patch Compliance
description: Implement automated patch management to achieve 95%+ patch compliance within 30 days of release.

title: Deploy SOAR Platform
description: Implement Security Orchestration, Automation and Response to automate repetitive security tasks.

title: Establish Post-Incident Review Process
description: Implement mandatory post-incident reviews for all security events to drive continuous improvement.

title: Add Threat Intelligence Feeds
description: Subscribe to 3+ threat intelligence feeds for proactive awareness of emerging threats.

title: Encrypt Data at Rest
description: Implement full-disk and database encryption to protect sensitive data from unauthorized access.

title: Hire Dedicated CISO
description: Appoint a Chief Information Security Officer to provide strategic security leadership.

title: Implement Security Metrics Dashboard
description: Track 20+ security KPIs and report to board quarterly to drive accountability.

title: Deploy Honeypots for Early Detection
description: Set up decoy systems to detect attackers early in the kill chain before damage occurs.
